create_RandAugment_transform: create a RandAugment transform with magnitude 10 and 2 random augmentation layers for PIL images
create_AutoAugment_transform: create an AutoAugment transform using the v0 policy to apply learned augmentation sequences to PIL images
create_AugmentOp_instance: create an AugmentOp instance for a specific augmentation like Rotate with custom probability and magnitude
use_auto_augment_policy: use auto_augment_policy to get a list of augmentation sub-policies by name such as v0 or original
use_rand_augment_ops: use rand_augment_ops to generate a list of AugmentOp instances for all default RandAugment transforms
